text: 【午盘播报】沪指上涨0.35%，报3955.85点；深成指上涨0.27%，报13661.39点；创业板指上涨0.43%，报3326.68点，两市半日合计成交12342亿。盘面上，饲料、养殖业、动物保健、渔业、广告营销、房地产服务、跨境支付、数字货币涨幅居前，贵金属、高带宽内存、MLCC、氦气概念、电子化学品、光刻机表现不佳，领跌市场。全市场上涨个股有4135家，下跌个股有1315家，45只股涨停。
text_en: 【午盘播报】The Shanghai Composite rose 0.35% to 3,955.85 points; Shenzhen Component rose 0.27% to 13,661.39; ChiNext rose 0.43% to 3,326.68, with half-day combined turnover of 1,234.2 billion yuan. Sectors leading gains included feed, aquaculture, animal health, fisheries, advertising, real estate services, cross-border payments, and digital currency; laggards included precious metals, high-bandwidth memory, MLCC, helium concepts, electronic chemicals, and lithography machines. Across the market, 4,135 stocks rose and 1,315 fell, with 45 hitting limit-up.
